spots.name: Pink Lady
spots.blurb: You've reached Pink Lady, a graffiti piece by Lynne Seemayer Westmore. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.

spots.name: Tapestry of Dreams (The Fabric of Community)
spots.blurb: You've reached Tapestry of Dreams (The Fabric of Community), a mural by Doolin, Matt from 2014. "The civic artwork at Fire Station 71 is a large tile mural on the building’s façade that references Malibu’s natural landscape and historic connection to artisan tile production. Tapestry of Dreams was inspired by the tile Persian rug located in the foye.
